nodes.description: Private address state variable holding the contract owner; written in constructor, changeOwner and read in getOwner / isOwner modifier.
Constructor that initializes owner to msg.sender and emits OwnerSet.
Public function guarded by isOwner modifier that updates owner to newOwner.
External view function returning the current owner address.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; acts as the access-control gate for changeOwner.
Caller-supplied address; used to set the initial owner and to authorize changeOwner.
State write owner = msg.sender performed during construction (owner initialization).
State write owner = newOwner performing a privileged ownership transfer.
Address parameter of changeOwner that becomes the new owner.

edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to determine the deployer.
msg.sender value flows into the owner initialization write.
Initialization write sets the owner state variable.
Modifier compares the untrusted msg.sender against owner to decide whether the caller is authorized.
isOwner modifier gates execution of changeOwner, enforcing owner-only access.
changeOwner parameter newOwner is consumed by the function body.
Execution of changeOwner reaches the ownership write operation.
newOwner parameter flows directly into the owner assignment.
Ownership write overwrites the owner state variable after authorization.
getOwner reads the owner state variable and returns it.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter newOwner is a non-core node whose only role is to feed the owner assignment inside changeOwner; it can be normalized into that core function node.
